ont.name: Fiber ONT
notes: ISP owned ONT in bridge mode. Public address 198.51.100.24 handed to OPNsense by DHCP.

opnsense.name: OPNsense
notes:
OPNsense edge firewall

Fanless four port box. 2.5GbE WAN to the ONT, 10GbE trunk to the core switch with every VLAN tagged.

  • DHCP and Unbound forwarding to AdGuard Home
  • Inter VLAN rules: IoT and Guest can only reach the internet
  • WireGuard on UDP 51820 for roaming devices
  • Nightly config backup to the NAS
VLANNameSubnet
10Mgmt10.10.10.0/24
20Servers10.10.20.0/24
30IoT10.10.30.0/24
40Guest10.10.40.0/24
99WireGuard10.10.99.0/24
[Interface]
Address = 10.10.99.1/24
ListenPort = 51820

[Peer]
# roaming laptop
AllowedIPs = 10.10.99.10/32

wireguard.name: WireGuard
notes: Runs on OPNsense. Peers get 10.10.99.0/24 and DNS from AdGuard Home.

offsite.name: Offsite Backup
notes: Encrypted restic repository. 30 daily, 12 monthly snapshots.

core.name: Core Switch
notes:
Port map

  • SFP+ 1: OPNsense trunk
  • SFP+ 2: PoE switch
  • SFP+ 3 to 5: pve1, pve2, NAS
  • SFP+ 8: spare

pve1.name: pve1
notes:
Proxmox node pve1

  • Ryzen 7, 64 GB ECC, 2 x 1 TB NVMe ZFS mirror
  • Dual 10GbE: vmbr0 VLAN aware bridge
  • Clustered with pve2, QDevice runs on the NAS
pvecm status
Quorate: Yes
Nodes: 2 plus QDevice
Total votes: 3

pve2.name: pve2
notes: Second cluster node. Mini PC, 32 GB RAM, 10GbE through a Thunderbolt adapter.

nas.name: NAS
notes:
Backups

  1. Proxmox Backup Server pulls every VM at 01:00
  2. NAS snapshots every hour, kept for 48 hours
  3. Offsite sync at 03:00, encrypted before upload

Rule: three copies, two media, one offsite.

notes:
Containers

  • Jellyfin
  • Immich
  • Vaultwarden
  • Uptime Kuma

adguard.name: AdGuard Home
notes: Primary DNS for every VLAN. Upstream DNS over TLS. Local zone lab.home.arpa.

caddy.name: Reverse Proxy
notes: Wildcard certificate for *.lab.home.arpa. Only reachable from LAN and WireGuard.

ap1.name: AP Living Room
notes: SSIDs: Willow (VLAN 10 and 20 by key), Willow IoT (VLAN 30), Willow Guest (VLAN 40).
10GbE trunk carrying VLAN 10, 30 and 40

list.content: Network overview with VLANs, Proxmox, storage and remote access

ha.name: Home Assistant
notes:
Automations

  • Good night: locks the front door, turns off downstairs lights, arms cameras
  • Doorbell: shows the camera on the TV and sends a phone alert
  • Leak: closes the water valve and flashes the hallway light red
  • Away: thermostat to eco, vacuum starts
trigger: state
entity_id: binary_sensor.washer_leak
to: "on"
